messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays that create **long weekends** (i.e., a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day weekend) in 2023:

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | ✔️ |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | ✔️ |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✔️ |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | ✔️ |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving Day | Monday | ✔️ |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | ✔️ |

> **Note:**  
> - Some provinces observe different holidays (e.g., Family Day is not a holiday in all provinces).  
> - If you’re planning trips in provinces that don’t observe Family Day, you’ll still have the other long weekends listed above.  

Feel free to plug this list into your holiday‑planning app! If you need more detailed provincial holiday calendars or want to include non‑federal holidays, let me know.
